page.content:
Gyokurō is a stocky boy with blue eyes, thin eyebrows, and dark hair, one strand of which hangs over his forehead on the right. He wears a blue tank top over which he wears a brown jacket and a blue scarf.

page.overview:
Who is Gyokurō Chabashira?

Gyokurō is a stocky boy with blue eyes, thin eyebrows, and dark hair, one strand of which hangs over his forehead on the right. He wears a blue tank top over which he wears a brown jacket and a blue scarf.

At the Training Hall, Gyokurō watched Boruto Uzumaki fight the Seventh Hokage alongside other genin.
